title: Is the ball heard where it matters?

criteria.claim: A full scream at 3 m in the living room is at least 10 dB above the room's background, enough to be understood.
criteria.source: Speech is understood reliably about 10-15 dB above background noise (ANSI/ASA S12.60 asks 15 dB for classrooms).

criteria.claim: The murmur is audible at half a metre in a quiet room (40 dBA), at least 5 dB above it.
criteria.source: Product requirement: you should hear it fretting in your hand.
